claims.statement: Article 14 grants a lawful battery purchaser or its agent non-discriminatory access to qualifying BMS state-of-health data for residual-value and reuse assessment.
The battery passport starts on 18 February 2027 for relevant batteries placed on the market or put into service, leaving a legacy-fleet coverage gap.
The Commission says connected-vehicle data remains fragmented and may require measures beyond the Data Act, so practical access is not standardized today.
AVILOO and DEKRA already offer rapid independent tests using model-specific algorithms and databases.
BCA already embeds AVILOO grading in European BEV auctions for EUR 40 per report, while AVILOO advertises a EUR 99 retail certificate.
Electrically chargeable cars were 3.7% of the EU car fleet in 2024, supporting a growing but still early installed base.
A new entrant's defensible asset would need certificate-linked Polish bid and resale outcomes; the certificate algorithm alone starts behind incumbents.

contrary_evidence: The diagnostic certificate and auction combination already exists at BCA.
Observed incumbent pricing is below the discovery-stage 700 PLN hypothesis.
EU law improves access but explicitly does not yet eliminate automotive data fragmentation.
